paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Micro-F1 scores for ChemDataExtractor and MatDetector across different values.
model_annotation: The line plot compares the Micro-F1 scores (%) of two methods, MatDetector (ours) and ChemDataExtractor, across various values of the hyperparameter λ, which ranges from 'w/o' (without) to 3 on a logarithmic scale. The y-axis represents the Micro-F1 Score in percentage, scaled from 52 to 58 with major gridlines at intervals of 1. The MatDetector (ours) method, represented by a solid magenta line with circular markers, shows a generally increasing trend in performance as λ increases, starting at approximately 52.8% at 'w/o' and peaking at 57.8% at λ = 1.0 before declining to around 53.3% at λ = 3. In contrast, the ChemDataExtractor method, shown as a dashed dark blue line with square markers, exhibits a more fluctuating pattern, starting at 52.9% at 'w/o', dipping to a low of 52.2% at λ = 0.3, then rising to a peak of 55.2% at λ = 1.0, and ending at approximately 54.2% at λ = 3. Overall, MatDetector (ours) achieves higher Micro-F1 scores than ChemDataExtractor across most λ values, particularly at higher values of λ.
